descriptive_title: Grade 3 Mathematics: Demonstrations — Estimating and Calculating Change (F1.1)
subject: Mathematics

curriculum_expectations.F1.1: estimate and calculate the change required for various simple cash transactions involving whole-dollar amounts and amounts of less than one dollar

unit_overview: A 5-day Grade 3 unit on cash transactions and change (F1.1) framed around 'Plan Your Party' — Pat the Party Planner Pup and Budget Bea the Bear. Day 1 introduces ESTIMATION of change for whole-dollar amounts. Day 2 calculates EXACT change for whole-dollar amounts. Day 3 handles AMOUNTS LESS THAN $1 (cents). Day 4 mixes whole-dollar AND cents transactions. Day 5 closes with a Big Party Capstone — children plan a party budget and calculate change. Each lesson includes an expanded_walkthrough.
unit_learning_goal: Children will estimate and calculate change for cash transactions in whole-dollar amounts and amounts under $1.

lesson_arc.big_idea: ESTIMATE first! Round prices to NEAREST DOLLAR, subtract from money paid.
lesson_arc.student_learning_goal: I can estimate change for whole-dollar transactions.
lesson_arc.one_line_summary: Pat estimates 4 transactions; children round and subtract.

lesson_arc.big_idea: EXACT change = MONEY PAID minus PRICE. Use subtraction.
lesson_arc.student_learning_goal: I can calculate exact change for whole-dollar transactions.
lesson_arc.one_line_summary: Bea calculates 4 transactions; children subtract carefully.

lesson_arc.big_idea: AMOUNTS UNDER $1 use CENTS (¢). Change is also in CENTS.
lesson_arc.student_learning_goal: I can calculate change in cents.
lesson_arc.one_line_summary: Pat calculates change for ¢ transactions; children try 4.

lesson_arc.student_learning_goal: I can calculate change for mixed transactions.

lesson_arc.big_idea: Plan a PARTY: pick items, total cost, pay, calculate change!
lesson_arc.student_learning_goal: I can plan a budget and calculate change.
lesson_arc.one_line_summary: Children plan a party with $20 budget and calculate change for 4 items.

pedagogical_notes: Grade 3 expands G2 from equivalence to TRANSACTIONS — paying and getting CHANGE.
Always ESTIMATE first — gives a check on the exact answer.
Subtraction is the core skill: Money Paid - Price = Change.
Cents transactions are tricky — keep clear notation.
Capstone budget makes it real: planning a party!
canadian_context_notes: Party items: maple cookies, hockey-stick balloons, Tim Hortons donuts.
No pennies in change (Canadian penny removed) — round to nearest 5¢.
Treat as EXACT amounts in classroom (no rounding for cash anymore in real life).
